title: Command: context
lead:
`adj context [--tag T] [--key-prefix P] [--format md|json]` gives a compact
summary of the accepted decisions.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 5; v1 feature tier; Risks (context bloat); Milestone 3
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** the supersede command itself, and a size budget flag (a
Risks mitigation in PROJECT.md, not in the v1 tier; adding it later is an owner
scope call, not an interface detail).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal 5: token-cheap context for agents. Output must be deterministic so
`context` diffs are stable.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/commands/context.go`.
- `internal/render/context.go`, `internal/render/context_test.go` and golden
  files in `internal/render/testdata/`.
- `internal/cli/context_test.go`.
- `docs/json.md`: the `context --format json` shape.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
End-to-end CLI tests call `cli.Run` in a fresh `t.TempDir()` store (with
`t.Chdir`, which rules out `t.Parallel`, or a root option the implementer adds
and records under C32), with a fixed clock where dates matter.

- A fixture store with one record per status: only the `decided` record
  appears; `open`, `rejected`, `withdrawn` and `superseded` do not.
- `--tag` and `--key-prefix` each filter the output, and combine with AND.
- `--format md` and `--format json` match their golden files; an unknown
  format is a usage error.
- Two runs on the same store give byte-identical output.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Select decided records with `query` and render a compact entry per record.
Implementer decides and records (C32): the fields in each entry (proposed: id,
title, key, decision, and the rationale's first line), the default format
(proposed: md), and the order (proposed: by ID). Document the JSON shape in
`docs/json.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run from the repo root after `. scripts/env.sh` (the in-repo cache env, C33;
use the equivalent AGENTS.md names if S02 chose another):

- `go test ./...` passes, including this slice's new tests.
- `go vet ./...` reports nothing.
- `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing (not `gofmt -l .`, which also walks
  `.cache/` and `.worktrees/`).
- Each interface choice made in this slice is a slicer catalog decision with a
  one-line reason (C32).
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
